app.name: Pac the Man X
app.short_description: Maze game with a level editor
app.long_description:
A port of the freeware Mac game Pac the Man X 1.5.1a by McSebi Software, with its level editor.
Clear each maze of dots while the Glooms hunt you. Play alone or with a friend, on four difficulty levels, on the 25 standard levels or your own.
Controls: Wii Remote held sideways, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller or USB keyboard. Player 1 uses port 1 and the arrow keys, player 2 port 2 and W A S D. + pauses, HOME on the title opens the preferences and the level editor.
